RoutedDuplicateAddressProof.ResetSource: PLL lock drives active-low two-register reset chain. Equivalence is claimed only after this reset establishes zero, not during the vendor models configuration window.

ExternalTimingBoundary: SDA synchronizer first stage is asynchronous. RTL tests assume1000ns rise/300ns fall and3450ns slave valid delay. Real pullups/voltage/clock tolerance remain unmeasured; no clock stretching or autonomous stuck-SDA bus clear. No MTBF or full external camera IO timing claim.
